newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gasoline still supported.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gasoline still supported.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, with fuel oil and gas oil weakening, but gasoline firming, dealers said.
Gasoline remained the key market prop as buying in the UK ahead of the November 26 budget supported Eurograde barges. Prices firmed, steady to firm compared with a confusing set of deals on Monday.
Amsterdam-Rotterdam material traded at $225. One trader, on Monday the buyer at $219.50 in a deal considered below the market, was one of the three sellers, dealers said.
Rotterdam running refinery changed hands at $227 fob ARA.

Heating oil barges were lower as underlying IPE futures sagged by almost $1. Premiums were broadly unchanged. Storage material was around IPE Nov -50 cents/flat, while refinery product was at IPE flat/+$1 fob ARA. Some majors were keen to shift barges, but buying in Germany was very weak.
"Many of the German wholesalers are short, but they are happy with that position as the market comes down," one trader said.
Lack of fuel oil demand left the high sulphur barge with little more than offers at $110 fob ARA, some $2/$3 down on Monday's close.
